t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Pick the yellow short hat or tall brown hat, if not available, pick the short hat

vb_textbox.text: At the start, keep an eye out for short yellow hat and tall brown hat, if there isn't either option, pick the short hat. Half way through, after the 2nd break, they do change so start picking the tall hat option and the other hat to yellow short hat and tall brown hat.
